static_findings.snippet: - If `CLOJURE_STYLE_GUIDE.adoc` exists in the working directory, also check compliance with the comm
- [ ] Public vars in `src` or `enterprise/backend/src` have useful docstrings
- [ ] `TODO` comments include author and date: `;; TODO (Name 2025-01-01) -- description`
- [ ] No `declare` when avoidable (public functions near end)
- [ ] No blank, non-comment lines within definition forms (except pairwise constructs in `let`/`cond
- [ ] Separate `deftest` forms for distinct test cases
- [ ] Query params use kebab-case, bodies use `snake_case`
- [ ] No raw MBQL manipulation outside `lib`, `lib-be`, or `query-processor` modules
- [ ] Uses `t2/select-one-fn` instead of selecting full rows for one column
- [ ] Passes `driver` argument to other driver methods (no hardcoded driver names)
- [ ] Kondo linter suppressions use proper format (not `#_:clj-kondo/ignore` keyword form)
| `;; TODO fix this`                           | Missing author/date: `;; TODO (Name 2025-01-01) --
| `(defn foo ...)` in namespace used elsewhere | Should be `(defn ^:private foo ...)`
| Query params with `snake_case`               | Use kebab-case for query params
> This pure function should be named as a noun describing its return value. Consider `user` instead
> This function is only used in this namespace, so it should be marked `^:private`.
> Query parameters should use kebab-case. Change `user_id` to `user-id`.
- Do not post comments confirming things "look good" or telling them they did something correctly

content.user_title: Review Clojure Style in Metabase Changes
content.value_statement: Clojure pull requests can miss project-specific style and architecture rules. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused Metabase review checklist.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Clojure and ClojureScript diffs for Metabase naming conventions.
Checks public vars, docstrings, TODO format, and private function markers.
Flags test organization issues such as test naming and parallel test metadata.
Checks module, REST API, MBQL, database, and driver convention rules.
Provides concise review comment examples for style violations.
limitations: It is tailored to Metabase conventions, not general Clojure style only.
It relies on visible diffs and files provided to the agent.
It does not replace clj-kondo, tests, or compiler checks.
It should not post positive comments when no issue exists.

use_cases.title: Review a Metabase backend pull request
use_cases.description: Find style, module, API, and database convention issues before merge.

use_cases.title: Check ClojureScript naming and tests
use_cases.description: Scan frontend-related ClojureScript changes for naming, test structure, and documentation concerns.

use_cases.title: Prepare contributor feedback
use_cases.description: Generate focused review comments that explain violations without praising correct code.

prompt_templates.title: Review a small diff
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one focused change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Clojure diff with the clojure-review skill. Flag only Metabase style or quality issues that need action.

prompt_templates.title: Check API conventions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Clojure API changes. Focus on route naming, schemas, query parameter casing, side effects, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit database and MBQL code
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Metabase data-layer change. Focus on Toucan usage, MBQL boundaries, table naming, and efficient selects.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a full Metabase Clojure review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the full Clojure and ClojureScript pull request. Apply the checklist across naming, docs, tests, modules, APIs, MBQL, database, and drivers.

output_examples.input: A diff adds a public helper without a docstring.
output_examples.output: This public var needs a docstring explaining its purpose, inputs, and outputs.

output_examples.input: A diff adds an endpoint using plural route nouns.
output_examples.output: Routes should use singular nouns. Consider changing the route to the singular resource form.

output_examples.input: A diff adds a private helper without private metadata.
output_examples.output: This function is only used in this namespace, so it should be marked private.

best_practices: Run this skill on focused diffs where Clojure or ClojureScript files changed.
Pair the review with clj-kondo, tests, and normal build checks.
Post only actionable comments about violations or potential issues.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to praise code that already follows the style guide.
Do not treat it as a substitute for test execution or linting.
Do not apply its Metabase-specific rules blindly to unrelated Clojure projects.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Clojure and ClojureScript changes against Metabase style, API, module, database, test, and driver conventions.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: The skill content is a review checklist. It does not require command execution to provide feedback.

faq.question: Can it replace automated linting?
faq.answer: No. Use it with clj-kondo, tests, and build checks for better coverage.

faq.question: Is it useful outside Metabase?
faq.answer: Only partly. Many checks are specific to Metabase naming, modules, routes, and driver conventions.

faq.question: What tools support it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should reviewers post?
faq.answer: Reviewers should post concise, actionable comments about style violations or potential issues only.
